DML.SELECT: SELECT plan_schedule_id as "id", plan_id as "planId", cron_expression as "cronExpression", alias as "alias", description as "description", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.plan_schedules WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.plan_schedules (plan_schedule_id, plan_id, cron_expression, alias, description, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.plan_schedules'$'plan_schedule_id'}, :planId, :cronExpression, :alias, :description, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.plan_schedules SET plan_id = :planId, cron_expression = :cronExpression, alias = :alias, description = :description, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE plan_schedule_id = :id
